system_prompt_style.note: meta_agent.py imports SYSTEM_PROMPT from prompts.py; prompts.py content not in evidence. Record name 'Agent Factory (HLS)' conflates arXiv 2603.25719 (IBM HLS paper) with the AgentFactory repo; coded from repo.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
The Meta-Agent uses the skill
list_saved_subagents to discover previously
saved skills that may be relevant to the current
task.

All tool skills include detailed
documentation on parameters and return formats.

tool_count.note: The count is 7 meta skills plus 4 tool skills. The tool skills may be allocated to subagents rather than exposed to the meta-agent. Saved subagent skills grow over time.

edit_primitive.note: create_subagent writes the full code. The params used by modify_subagent are not shown.

companying SKILL.md file documenting its func-
tionality, parameters, and usage.
